realReviews.author: Hedlow Retreat
realReviews.text: We engaged Tony from TMC Carpentry to complete some improvements at Hedlow Retreat and we couldn't be happier with the result. Tony was professional, reliable, and delivered a high-quality finish that has significantly improved the functionality and appearance of the space. His workmanship, attention to detail, and communication throughout the project were excellent. We would highly recommend TMC Carpentry to anyone looking for quality carpentry work.

finalCta.headline: Got a carpentry job that needs doing?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send photos and a few details through the form, or give Tony a call. We'll look at the job and send a written quote.
Rockhampton and the surrounding area. Not sure if you're in range? Just ask.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Give us a call for a quote for all of your carpentry, big or small.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
